# Pipeline notes

Stages run in order; each stage retries at most twice.

kg.auth src:
KG: Token validation pattern | src=src/auth.py
JWT signature and expiry validation lives in validate_token; parse_token normalises the raw header.
kg.notes docs:
KG: Notes on the pipeline | src=docs/notes.md
The queue pipeline notes describe stage ordering and the retry policy.
kg.parser lib:
KG: Parser contract | src=lib/parser.rs
parse_header returns a Header; callers must handle a malformed header.
kg.router src:
KG: Request routing | src=src/router.py
login_handler wires authentication into the request router.
kg.auth src validate_token:
KG: Token expiry check | src=src/auth.py
Add an expiry guard before the signature check inside validate_token.
kg.wire the new session store into the rout:
KG: Session store wiring | src=src/session.py
SessionStore.refresh_session is the entry point for session rotation.
